jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

What You Will Do

You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

What You Could Bring

This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

How We Work

You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Veo is the world’s leading AI powered and affordable football camera solution. We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Democratizing football, by giving access to video analysis, that in the past only were available for the few. The innovative dual-lense camera technology records the entire pitch at all times, with two 4K high resolution sports action lenses. Our intelligent software automatically follows the ball to create a broadcast view, while allowing you the controls with a simple click of you mouse. Our solution is developing better athletes. We know players are visual learners, seeing themselves play rather than being told of their mistakes is more effective and likely to produce results.

💰 🇩🇰 up to 46,000 DKK gross/month (depending on seniority level)

Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully - and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people - sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Jun/Mid Level Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us - through the grind and the wins.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• 
Owned an OCPP hardening project - chased down a recurring class of vendor quirks (malformed messages, connection drops, the long tail of hardware oddities), shipped the fix, and measurably cut failed sessions or disconnections for that device family.

• 
Helped shift the team from reacting to incidents to preventing them, through alerting and observability work that catches problems earlier.

• 
Made real progress on OCPP 1.6, OCPP 2.0.1, and OCPI standards work that other services and front-ends across Monta now rely on.

What You Will Do

• 
Build and maintain backend services in NetOps' OCPP and charge point domain - protocol handling, message processing, device state, integrations with hardware vendors.

• 
Debug things that only break in the field. A charge point in Belgium disconnects every 40 minutes - you'll read the OCPP traffic, reproduce it against our emulator, find the cause, and fix it.

• 
Improve observability and alerting. Add the metrics, dashboards, and alerts that mean the next person doesn't have to guess.

• 
Take part in on-call once you're ramped up, with a team that treats a rough night as a reason to fix the system, not a rite of passage.

• 
Automate manual work away - a meaningful part of NetOps' job is removing the human steps that don't scale as our network grows.

• 
Collaborate across Product, Support, and the operations teams who live with the consequences of what we ship. You won't work in a silo.

A brief overview of our tech stack:

• 
Kotlin services (JVM), with Java where it already lives

• 
PHP/Laravel monolith - parts of our charge point domain still run here

• 
OCPP 1.6 / 2.0.1 and OCPI protocol handling

• 
Event-driven work with Kafka where message volume calls for it

• 
Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• 
AWS + Kubernetes, with Terraform for infrastructure

What We’re Looking For

• 
1–4 years of backend engineering experience, or a strong junior track record with real production exposure. You write clean, readable code and finish what you start.

• 
Comfortable in a JVM language - Kotlin preferred, Java fine, and we'll help you get there from another stack if the fundamentals are strong. Willingness to touch PHP in our legacy monolith when the work calls for it.

• 
You enjoy debugging, genuinely - logs, traces, packet-level detail, weird one-off reports from a single customer.

• 
A sense of ownership - you follow your work into production, watch it, and flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked.

• 
Nice to have: curiosity about the physical world (our systems talk to metal boxes with electricity in them); clear communication - you can explain what broke and why to someone who isn't an engineer; advanced, deliberate use of AI tools in your daily engineering workflow.

• 
Bonus points for: exposure to OCPP, OCPI, EV charging, or the EV industry as a driver or enthusiast; IoT, embedded, or telemetry systems where devices in the field misbehave; event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-volume message processing; reliability/monitoring/on-call experience (Prometheus, Grafana, SLOs); Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code exposure.

If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

AI Competency

• 
You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• 
GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• 
ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• 
Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• 
Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• 
AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

• 
We don’t expect mastery of all - but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

Why Monta

• 
Impact, not easy mode - your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• 
Ownership from day one - we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• 
The grind is real - priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• 
The people are extraordinary - talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• 
A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• 
A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• 
Free lunch every day.

• 
Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• 
Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• 
Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• 
Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is the operating platform powering the EV charging ecosystem serving drivers, companies, cities, and the electricity grid with one integrated software solution. We believe that accelerating and democratising the adoption of EV technology is key to building a better future. Monta’s mission is to provide the best technology solutions for the entire EV charging cycle. At our core, we provide access, innovation, and reliability to the mobility transformation. We're here to make the transition to electric mobility as seamless and exciting as possible. With a single integrated software built to EV better. Founded in 2020 our team has been growing fast and are now more than 200 employees with 47 different nationalities. Our HQ is based in Copenhagen, and we have offices in Oslo, Berlin, Paris, London and just opened Barcelona. Our culture is based on trust, transparency, and respect, where everyone contributes to making Monta what it is. You don't have to work 9-17, we trust our people to know how they work best. We empower each team to choose how and when they work. Inclusion is also a big part of our culture, and we make sure that everybody feels welcome, heard and able to bring all of who they are to work. We take it upon ourselves to protect this space that has allowed us to get this far. Monta is dedicated to encouraging a supportive, diverse and inclusive culture amongst all Monteers as they are fundamental to our values as a company. One of the best things about Monta is our people. Right from the get-go you will feel how inclusive, diverse, sociable and friendly our team is. We go to the office as much as possible, not because we have to, but because we enjoy each other's company - even outside work hours we hang out together. We have lots of different clubs you can join, there's a chess club, a ski club, (there's a slack channel for every little interest we can bond over). Everyone is very passionate about what we do and invested in the product and their role. We are a team of innovators, experts, and “bar-setters” in our fields. We believe that we can create the path needed to sustainably scale the industry towards the future. We're biased toward action, so we're always looking for ways to improve and make things work for many, not just few. We don't just want to be good at what we do—we want to be the best at it. Better results, better technology, better systems, better together. The combination of all this, and the feeling that we are contributing something great to the world, gives everyone a strong sense of belonging and makes our employees and customers want to work with us - it helps our company thrive. Everyone here is proud to be a 'Monteer'. If you’d like to work in a green, tech-driven company and are passionate about innovation, we might be the right fit! We've got an incredible team, and hope to find more peers who can help us push things even further.

**About The Job

**Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and help strengthen the bank’s privileged access management capabilities. You will be responsible for implementing, operating, and continuously improving PAM controls that protect privileged accounts, administrative access, and critical systems across Saxo’s technology landscape.

Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams, you will help reduce privileged access risk through modern PAM practices, automation, and Zero Trust principles.

**Responsibilities

**

• Implement and manage privileged access controls across on-premises and cloud environments

• Administer PAM capabilities including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, and privileged session recording

• Onboard privileged accounts, systems, applications, and service accounts into the PAM platform

• Support adoption of least-privilege, Just-In-Time (JIT), and Zero Trust access models

• Automate PAM processes and integrations using PowerShell and APIs

• Support monitoring, reporting, audits, and access to governance activities

**Your profile

**You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with a strong background in Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), and security engineering. You combine deep technical expertise with a practical, risk-based approach to securing critical systems and privileged access within complex enterprise environments.

• 7-10 years of experience in Privileged Access Management, Identity & Access Management, or Cyber Security Engineering

• Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions

• Strong understanding of privileged access risks, account lifecycle management, and security best practices

• Experience securing Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, databases, and network devices

• Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Azure environments

• Experience with automation and scripting, including PowerShell and APIs

• Experience working in regulated environments, preferably within financial services

Certifications & Platforms

You have practical experience working with leading PAM technologies and understand how privileged access controls support a broader security strategy. Experience with multiple platforms is highly valued, particularly in enterprise-scale environments.

• Experience with Delinea Secret Server or other Delinea PAM solutions will be considered a strong advantage

• Experience with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, One Identity, or similar PAM platforms is also highly valued

**Personal competencies

**You are a structured and proactive professional who thrives on solving complex security challenges. You can effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders and translate business and security requirements into practical solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities

• Structured, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset

• Ability to translate security requirements into practical technical solutions

• Strong collaboration skills and a continuous improvement mindset

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

jobs.occupation: Global Process Owner, Order to Cash, ERP Transformation
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Process Owner, Order to Cash to be based in Denmark

In this role, you will own Ambu’s global end-to-end Order to Cash process within our ERP transformation, covering sales planning, order management, distribution, invoicing, customer service and collections. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with dual reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Transformation, and work closely with Global Business Owners, other Global Process Owners, Commercial, IT, Finance, Quality and site leadership.

This is a unique opportunity to create a globally aligned Order to Cash capability and set the standard for how it operates across Ambu. It will suit an experienced leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to deliver transformation at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Owning the global Order to Cash process vision, standards, governance and roadmap

• Acting as Business Workstream Lead and driving fit-to-standard design

• Leading process decisions that balance service, cash, compliance and customer experience

• Establishing process KPIs and driving readiness and adoption across countries

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have 10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations or business transformation, from industry or consulting

• Have deep expertise across the complete Order to Cash value stream

• Are comfortable working across time zones and travelling across Ambu’s global footprint

• Have experience from a regulated environment, ideally medical devices, life sciences or pharmaceuticals

• Have led large-scale ERP-enabled transformations or Order to Cash workstreams

• Are structured, proactive and outcome-oriented, with strong stakeholder management skills

• Have SAP S/4HANA, Infor, Oracle Cloud or similar experience and strong written and spoken English

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

• Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).

• New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).

• New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.

• Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.

• A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.

Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

• Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.

• Value a strong professional network across hospitals.

• Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.

• Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.

• Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.

• On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).

About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

• The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.

• Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

About Electricity Maps

Electricity Maps is a VC-backed climate and energy tech start-up building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. We provide real-time, historical, and forecasted data on electricity systems worldwide - covering generation mix, electricity prices, carbon intensity, and renewable share.

Our data powers decisions across sustainability and energy markets: from companies like Google and Cisco optimising compute workloads and reporting emissions, to energy market participants using our forecasts to inform trading strategies and asset optimisation. We're a small, technical team based in Copenhagen, working at the intersection of energy, AI, climate change, and data.

About the role

You'll work in the product team responsible for exposing our data to the world and you will help people and companies consume our data: Via our API, our map or whatever makes sense next.

We believe in engineers owning product decisions. Engineers scope the problem, build it and evolve it based on feedback from customers, colleagues and users. Those decisions usually aren't mapped out before you start on them so you're figuring out the shape of the problem and the best solution as you unpack it.

You'll be part of a small engineering team with 3 other full-stack engineers. No two days look the same. Most of your energy goes into building and figuring out solutions, with bug fixes and other tasks mixed in.

What you'll do

• 
Build and ship across the stack (we’re using TypeScript for 95% of the product surface).

• 
Own the systems that touch customers directly, from how we onboard, guide and support them to how we serve data in the API they integrate with.

• 
Decide what to build in collaboration with leadership, sales, marketing and data teams.

• 
Care about your solutions being actually used and understand what matters to our users: dig deeper in analytics, join commercial conversations, be curious.

• 
Push on new ways customers can interact with our data. Maybe new API capabilities, new functionality in the map or something else.

• 
Dig into bugs and edge cases.

What you won't do

• 
Ship something and never find out if anyone uses it.

• 
Wait around for permission to fix something you can see is broken.

• 
Spend more time in alignment meetings than building.

What we're looking for

• 
6+ years of hands-on experience shipping full-stack features in production and scaling them.

• 
Early-stage tech company / product experience.

• 
Product mindset, meaning that you build with the user in mind and have strong, defensible opinions on what "good" looks like; in code, in product, in process.

• 
Comfortable with data-heavy products, where edge cases and correctness can play a big part.

• 
Founder mentality, meaning that you are excited about building new products and taking them from an early stage to something users rely on. You spend time across the organization to deepen your knowledge and learn how users interact with the product to build things that are used.

Our stack

Relevant to this role: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP. The ideal candidate has worked in or close to these systems.

The details

Location: Copenhagen (office first, with flexibility)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options

Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at the office

Electricity Maps

See company profile

Electricity Maps provides real-time, historical, and forecasted electricity data - including carbon intensity, electricity mix, and prices - for more than 350 regions worldwide. We help businesses cut emissions with confidence, and enable products and services to differentiate by giving end-users the tools to be carbon-aware. We also serve power markets directly: energy traders and market participants use our forecasts to anticipate prices and grid conditions ahead of time. Wind and solar output fluctuates throughout the day, so this data has to be dynamic and updated in real time. And because claims about the physical origin of electricity get scrutinized and challenged, the effort behind it has to be collaborative, open, and transparent - otherwise it's just another unverifiable "100% renewable" claim. That's what motivated Electricity Maps. It started as an open-source real-time visualization in June 2016, founded by Olivier Corradi, and has grown into a comprehensive data platform trusted by companies like Google, Cisco, and Schneider Electric to hit their climate goals and help their users take real, grid-grounded climate action. Our mission: to decarbonise electricity, by building and continuing to build the world's most comprehensive, granular, and useful electricity data platform.

jobs.occupation: Assistant or Senior | Banking & Insurance Audit & Assurance
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Are you passionate about the financial services sector and ready to contribute to high-quality audits in one of the most complex, dynamic and highly regulated industries? We are looking for talented audit professionals to join our Banking & Insurance team in Deloitte Denmark.

We serve a broad range of clients, from major Nordic banks and insurance companies to specialised financial services providers. Our work combines strong audit quality, deep sector knowledge and close collaboration as we help clients navigate complex financial reporting, regulatory and risk-related requirements.

Our Audit & Assurance Banking & Insurance practice brings together approximately 35 professionals. You will join an environment where quality and professional development come first, supported by structured learning, mentorship and exposure to challenging, real-world assignments. We value collaboration, different perspectives and an inclusive culture where people can contribute authentically and develop their careers.

Whether you aspire to become a state-authorised public accountant, deepen your expertise within banking or insurance, or build a broader profile combining audit and advisory experience, we will support your development. Join a community committed to continuous learning and creating lasting value for financial institutions across the Nordics.

Job Description

As an Assistant or Senior in our Banking & Insurance practice, you will play a central role in delivering high-quality audit and assurance services to commercial banks, investment banks, insurance companies and other regulated financial institutions across the Nordics.

Your responsibilities will span the audit lifecycle, from planning and risk assessment to execution and reporting. Depending on your experience level, you will either contribute to defined audit areas with support from experienced colleagues or take broader ownership of workstreams, client interactions and the development of junior team members. Your work will focus on financial reporting, regulatory requirements, operational risks and emerging topics such as cybersecurity, data and digital transformation.

The position is based in our Copenhagen office. Your work will include time at client locations.

In this role, you will

• Own audit workstreams appropriate to your experience level, demonstrating initiative and sound judgement in complex situations.

• Contribute to consistently high audit quality by applying professional scepticism, robust methodology and attention to detail.

• Develop deep sector knowledge of banking and insurance, including the regulatory frameworks, business models and risk profiles that shape these industries.

• Build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues through professionalism, reliability and a genuine interest in their success.

• Use analytical tools and data-driven approaches to identify relevant risks, patterns and insights.

• Mentor and support junior team members, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

• Use data analytics, automation and AI-enabled tools to support risk assessment, test relevant populations and identify patterns, anomalies and risk indicators that require further audit attention.

You will work in a collaborative environment where your voice is heard, your development is prioritised and your contributions influence how we serve our clients.

Qualifications

You hold a master's degree in accounting, auditing or a related field, or you are actively pursuing such a qualification.

What we're looking for:

• 2–6 years of audit experience, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership of assignments and drive progress.

• A strong analytical mindset: You are curious about how things work, comfortable with data and numbers, and able to identify patterns and anomalies.

• Risk-oriented thinking: You understand that audit is fundamentally about risk assessment and can apply this perspective to complex business scenarios.

• Clear communication: You can explain complex financial and regulatory topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluent Danish: You can communicate confidently in Danish, both verbally and in writing, as you will work with Danish clients and documentation. This is a requirement for the role.

• Strong English skills: You can work effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, as English is our firm language.

• A genuine interest in people: You listen actively, support colleagues and recognise the value of diverse teams.

• A commitment to growth: You are eager to deepen your expertise, learn from experienced professionals and support the development of others.

Even if you do not meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply if you believe you can contribute meaningfully to our team.

What we offer:

• Continuous learning and development: Access to technical training, sector-specific workshops, professional development programmes and support from experienced colleagues.

• Exposure to leading financial institutions: Opportunities to understand how the Nordic banking and insurance sectors operate.

• Structured mentorship: Guidance from experienced partners and senior colleagues who are invested in your development.

• Flexibility and autonomy: Trust and support to manage your work within flexible working arrangements.

• A vibrant community: A team that values professional connection as well as social activities and events.

• Career pathways: Support whether your ambition is state authorisation, leadership, sector specialisation or a broader audit and advisory profile.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your application, CV, a brief cover letter outlining your interest in banking and insurance audit and assurance work. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Please do not hesitate to contact Contact Kristian Ehrenreich Hansen, Partner, or Lica Lyngsø Møller, Partner. They would be happy to discuss the role and our Banking & Insurance team.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

The Senior Manager, Quality Global Affiliates Excellence, develops and owns selected shared Quality processes that enable Genmab’s affiliates to operate compliantly and efficiently as the business expands. The role simplifies ways of working, reduces duplication and affiliate workload, and builds scalable solutions that can be deployed across existing and new markets.

Working closely with affiliate Quality leads, global process owners and cross-functional partners, the role combines process ownership with hands-on implementation. A key responsibility is ownership of the affiliate training framework, including shared curricula, governance and ongoing maintenance. The scope of other process ownership is agreed with the Head of Quality Global Affiliates and relevant global process owners, with clear interfaces to local responsibilities.

The role serves as a key connection point between Global Quality and affiliate Quality organizations, coordinating implementation activities, promoting standardization, and enabling the exchange of best practices and lessons learned across markets.

Responsibilities

Affiliate QMS and launch readiness

• Support new affiliate establishment, onboarding of local Quality leads and Responsible Persons, and implementation of the global Quality Management System. Work with local experts to identify and address additional local requirements

• Coordinate Quality readiness activities for market entry and commercial launches, tracking dependencies, milestones and risks and escalating issues requiring decisions or additional resources

• Support inspection readiness through shared tools, knowledge exchange and follow-up on recurring findings and improvement opportunities

Process ownership and scalable ways of working

• Own the design, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of assigned affiliate processes, including procedures, tools, governance, performance measures and user support

• Review affiliate workflows with local Quality leads to identify duplication, unnecessary complexity and activities that can be managed centrally or through shared services. Prioritise improvements based on compliance risk, affiliate effort and business needs

• Move agreed repeatable activities into shared solutions with clear responsibilities, handovers and support arrangements, reducing the need for each affiliate to develop and maintain its own approach

• Partner with global process owners to make global Quality processes practical for affiliates. Establish a common core with justified local adaptations, preserving local Quality oversight and statutory responsibilities

Affiliate training framework

• Own and maintain the affiliate training framework in partnership with Global Training, including role and task curricula, assignment principles, onboarding pathways and change governance

• Lead the affiliate training coordinator network and coordinate consistent implementation across markets. Maintain shared training matrices and coordinate updates following changes to global procedures

• Establish efficient arrangements for training assignment, administration and reporting with Global Training and affiliate coordinators. Retain clear local responsibility for identifying local requirements and confirming role applicability

• Monitor training completion and effectiveness, address recurring gaps with relevant stakeholders, and simplify training requirements and administration where justified

Quality oversight and continuous improvement

• Streamline affiliate Quality Management Reviews through common inputs, reporting and follow-up tools, and facilitate Quality Risk Management activities across affiliates

• Use process performance, affiliate feedback, inspection findings and workload data to identify improvements. Measure benefits through reduced duplication and effort, timely implementation and sustained process effectiveness

• Partner with relevant system owners to introduce proportionate digitalisation and automation

Project delivery and capability building

• Lead cross-functional improvement projects from problem definition through implementation and benefit evaluation, managing priorities and dependencies across multiple affiliates

• Build stakeholder commitment, provide practical guidance and training, and follow through on adoption so that improvements become part of everyday work

• Capture and share best practices and lessons learned through reusable guidance, peer networks and onboarding materials, strengthening the capabilities of small affiliate Quality teams

Requirements

• Master’s degree in pharmacy, life sciences, engineering or a related scientific discipline

• Approximately 7–10 years of relevant Quality experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry

• Strong understanding of Good Distribution Practice and other GxP requirements relevant to affiliate operations, with experience implementing or improving Quality Management Systems

• Demonstrated experience owning or substantially improving processes across multiple markets or functions, with measurable gains in simplicity, efficiency or effectiveness

• Experience with Quality Risk Management and inspection readiness, including the ability to coordinate these activities across multiple markets

• Experience developing and implementing Quality guidance, tools, and training to enable structured, consistent, and scalable ways of working across affiliates

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement capabilities, with the ability to identify trends, simplify processes, and drive harmonization across markets with differing regulatory requirements

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and local organizations and drive outcomes without direct authority

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK666.400,00---999.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

We offer a position with a diverse portfolio of projects—from simple to highly complex—where you will play a key role in driving innovation across software, mechanics, electronics, and sustainability. You will join a skilled Engineering team of specialists in mechanical design, electronics, and software.

**Project Management with a Focus on Structure and Communication

**You will be responsible for planning and executing your own projects from the early specification phase to production release or customer handover. This includes managing communication with internal stakeholders and external suppliers throughout the project lifecycle. You will handle several projects simultaneously, each at different stages. Most importantly, you will ensure alignment with the product roadmap and timelines, including:

• Estimating project scope, budget and timeline in collaboration with specialists and key stakeholders

• Effective project planning, including scheduling and booking internal resources

• Ensuring strong collaboration within the project organization and with subcontractors

• Driving progress while keeping a close eye on technical solutions, risk management, and cost control

• Supporting and clarifying concepts that align with the company’s as well as our customers’ focus areas, such as IoT, Industry 4.0, and sustainability

This is an independent and challenging role where you will have plenty of opportunities to influence the development of cutting-edge solutions.

Although our activities span the globe and our customers include some of the biggest brands in the appliance industry, this position is primarily internally focused, with only limited travel required.

**Your Background

**You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (B.Sc or M.Sc) or an equivalent academic qualification, giving you a solid foundation to act as a trusted partner for our business. In addition, we expect that you:

• Have 5+ years of experience as a project manager, preferably within the field of mechatronic

• Have a detail-oriented, structured, and consistent approach to your work

• Have solid financial insight and understanding

• Value well-documented project processes

As a person, you are an accomplished project leader who knows how to bring a team together and deliver optimal results. You are an excellent communicator who fosters collaboration across all functions without losing sight of the project goals. You maintain focus and overview throughout the entire process, ensuring strong results through close internal and external contact.

Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level is a must.

**What We Offer

**As a Project Manager, you will enjoy a dynamic workday involving collaboration with suppliers and colleagues worldwide. AGRAMKOW is a make-to-order company, giving you a broad interface with sales, engineering, development, purchasing, and production. Your workplace will be at our headquarters in Sønderborg, and physical presence is required. This is not a hybrid or remote position.

AGRAMKOW is the leading supplier of sustainable end-of-line solutions to manufacturers in the refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pump industries. The company is headquartered in Sønderborg and employs 180 people in Europe, Asia, North America and South America. The sales and service staff is supported by an extensive network of partners, ensuring local support for all customers.

Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. På grund av ökad aktivitet söker vi en stabil, självständig och ansvarsfull kranförare som sätter säkerhet och kundnöjdhet i centrum vid utförandet av uppdrag i Region Öst. Din fasta utgångspunkt kommer i första hand att vara i Hvidovre.

• Följa gällande säkerhetsföreskrifter.

• Hålla fordonet/kranen rent samt utföra mindre reparationer.

• Rapportera fel och brister på fordonet/kranen till verkstaden.

• Ge god service till kunderna.

Kvalifikationer och kompetenser

• Du har gärna erfarenhet från liknande arbete.

• Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta i team.

• Du vet vad det innebär att vara en professionell kranförare och vilka krav det ställer på dig.

• Du är flexibel när det gäller arbetstider.

• Du tar ansvar, är målmedveten och har ett smittande engagemang.

• Du är pålitlig och stabil.

• Du talar och förstår danska och engelska.

• Du har krankort B och gärna E.

• Du har körkort C/E.

• Du har digitalt förarkort.

• Du har yrkeskompetensbevis (YKB) för godstransporter.

• Du har truckkort.

Vi erbjuder

Ett spännande och självständigt arbete med många utmaningar, stor frihet under ansvar och en informell arbetsmiljö. Vi erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor med bland annat tjänstepension, sjukvårdsförsäkring och en aktiv personalförening.

Vi säkerställer en grundlig utbildning i körning av mobil tornkran.

Efter avslutad utbildning får du ansvar för din egen mobila tornkran.

Ansökan

Har tjänsten fångat ditt intresse? Skicka då gärna en kort ansökan så snart som möjligt genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök om tjänsten”.

Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

BMS A/S är Danmarks ledande leverantör av krantjänster. Därutöver har vi betydande verksamhet inom lastbilsliftar, tunglyft, transporter och uthyrning av körplåtar. Våra skickliga medarbetare servar dagligen kunder inom bland annat bygg- och anläggningsbranschen, industrin, telekomsektorn, olje- och gasindustrin samt vindkraftsbranschen.

BMS A/S är en del av BMS-koncernen, som totalt har över 2 000 medarbetare verksamma i bland annat Danmark, Sverige, Norge, Finland, Tyskland, Polen, Storbritannien, USA och Australien. Head of Data Platform – build Gubra’s data foundation from the ground up

Do you want to build the data foundation behind scientific innovation in a growing biotech company? Gubra is looking for a Head of Data Platform to take end-to-end ownership of a new enterprise data platform connecting scientific, operational, and business data across the organisation.

This is a director-level role combining technical ownership, people leadership, and greenfield development. You will shape the architecture and roadmap, build the team around the platform, and remain close enough to the technology to take part in key technical decisions.

The ambition is to create a scalable data foundation that supports research, laboratory operations, machine learning, and selected business functions across Gubra.

Build the platform – and the team around it

Gubra is investing in its digital and data foundation, and you will join at an early stage.

As Head of Data Platform, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of the platform, built around AWS and Databricks. You will work across architecture, data pipelines, reusable data products, governance, and security while translating scientific and business needs into technical priorities.

At the same time, you will build and lead the data engineering team. Two Data Engineers are planned to join, an external Data Architect is already supporting the initial design, and the team is expected to grow further. You will report directly to the CTO and become part of the CTO’s leadership team.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading the design and development of a scalable and secure enterprise data platform

• Building reliable data pipelines and reusable data products for scientists, ML teams, engineers, and business users

• Defining the platform roadmap and driving key architectural and technical decisions

• Establishing data governance, security, access control, and documentation standards

• Building, mentoring, and developing the data engineering team

• Working closely with stakeholders across research, laboratory operations, software engineering, and the wider business.

Who are you?

You have a strong background in data engineering, analytics, or data platforms and experience leading both people and technical delivery. You combine leadership with enough technical depth to challenge architectural decisions and engage credibly with engineers.

You bring extensive experience with AWS and Databricks and have designed scalable, secure, and governed data solutions before. Experience with lakehouse architecture, data mesh, medallion architecture, Airflow, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog is an advantage.

Experience from biotech, pharma, life sciences, or another research-intensive environment is beneficial but not required. The same applies to experience with regulated environments and GxP.

Personally, you are a pragmatic and collaborative leader who can create a clear direction, bring stakeholders and employees with you, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

About Gubra

Gubra is a purpose-driven biotech company where technology, data, and science come together to create life-changing therapies. The organisation combines Biotech, CRO, and Venture activities and brings scientists, engineers, and business teams together across the organisation.

Digital, Data & IT is strengthening the foundation beneath this work by connecting scientific, operational, and business data and enabling advanced analytics and machine learning.

The position is based at Gubra in Hørsholm, Denmark.

If you have any questions about the position, you are always welcome to contact Kathrine Schlegel Rasmussen at ksr@capaxrecruitment.com.

Capax Recruitment manages the recruitment process on behalf of Gubra.
